    Mixer

    Download

    Every export is drawn frame by frame from the film itself, 1920 by 1080 at 24 frames a second. The MP4 carries one stereo track mixed from the ticked channels. Each stem is a separate 48 kHz WAV at full level, exactly as long as the film, so they line up in any editor. Use Chrome or Edge for MP4.
